error[ZBX-E0606]: --listen needs --net none and --listen-send
  cause  --listen is for a container with no network of its own (--net none); a
         container with a network reaches the host without it
  fix    hand the listener to the Unix socket you pass down as descriptor 3:   zbx run --listen 127.0.0.1:8080 --listen-send 3 alpine -- sh
  more   zbx explain E0606 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0606.html
